SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::integer AS order_year,
       territory_id,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0)::numeric(24,4) AS subtotal_sum,
       COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount), 0)::numeric(24,4) AS tax_sum,
       COALESCE(SUM(freight), 0)::numeric(24,4) AS freight_sum,
       COALESCE(SUM(total_due), 0)::numeric(24,4) AS total_due_sum
FROM public.aw_orders
